% Styles for the TikZ figures of the harmonic-quotient paper.
% Generated by verification/make_figures.py.  Vertex y of Gamma_1 and the
% fiber phi^{-1}(y) in Gamma_2 are filled with color hq<y>.
\definecolor{hq0}{HTML}{FFFFFF}
\definecolor{hq1}{HTML}{6CC56C}
\definecolor{hq2}{HTML}{7BA7E0}
\definecolor{hq3}{HTML}{EE7B7B}
\definecolor{hq4}{HTML}{F2D24B}
\definecolor{hq5}{HTML}{F5A35C}
\definecolor{hq6}{HTML}{B99AE0}
\definecolor{hq7}{HTML}{7FD4D4}
\definecolor{hq8}{HTML}{C8A27C}
\definecolor{hq9}{HTML}{B0B0B0}
\tikzset{
  hqgraph/.style={line cap=round},
  hqv/.style={circle, draw=black, line width=0.4pt, inner sep=0pt,
              minimum size=4.6mm, font=\scriptsize},
  hqe/.style={line width=0.5pt},
}
